title: Course Schedule

contractDetails.constraints: 1–2000 courses and up to 5000 distinct prerequisite pairs. Each label is in [0, numCourses). A self-prerequisite is a cycle.

statement: Courses are labeled from zero. Each pair [course, prerequisite] requires the second course to finish before the first can begin. Determine whether you can finish all courses.

examples.explanation: Take 0, then 1, then 3. Course 2 is independent.
The three prerequisites form a cycle.

constraints: 1–2000 courses and up to 5000 distinct prerequisite pairs. Each label is in [0, numCourses). A self-prerequisite is a cycle.
hints: Conceptual: A cycle can make courses wait for one another indefinitely.
Directional: Track how many prerequisites each course still needs.
Implementation: Start with all zero-in-degree courses and reduce the counts of their dependents. Check how many courses finish.
complexityAnalysis: O(V + E) time and space for directed adjacency and in-degrees.
